Name: A feline patch of darkness (Black cat to replace the ginger cat)
Author: lemurkat
Description:
The ginger cat transformed into a pixel representation of my real-life cat, Lucie. I made her for personal use and as a gimmick, but thought she might be fun to share, because black cats need more love.

She's black and fluffy, with only the slightest of highlights. Basically, a void cat.
Replaces the icon on the  inventory page.
So simple it barely qualifies as a mod. To install, just drag the folder into your "mods" folder.

Yes, the original Lucie's tail really does curl like that. It's called a hypermobile tail and when she's happy, it lays almost flat along her spine.

Requires Content Patcher.
